notes: Specific dates for the initial MATIC distribution have been estimated using the release schedule chart in the source material.
POL replaced MATIC in Sept 2023. The DefaultEmissionManager mints 2% annual inflation (compounded), split 50/50 between Validator Staking Rewards and the Community Treasury.
Staking Rewards section covers the pre-allocated 12% of initial supply distributed as MATIC staking rewards through Dec 2022.

Validator Staking Emissions.methodology: 1% annual POL inflation (compounded) minted by the DefaultEmissionManager and sent to the PoS StakeManager contract for validator rewards.

pol-staking-inflation.name: POL Staking Inflation
pol-staking-inflation.methodology: Tracks 50% of POL minted by the DefaultEmissionManager via Transfer events from the zero address on Ethereum.

Community Treasury Emissions.methodology: 1% annual POL inflation (compounded) minted by the DefaultEmissionManager and sent to the Community Treasury for ecosystem growth.

pol-treasury-inflation.name: POL Treasury Inflation
pol-treasury-inflation.methodology: Tracks 50% of POL minted by the DefaultEmissionManager via Transfer events from the zero address on Ethereum.
